parameters.query: SELECT value FROM app_config WHERE key = 'onboarding_code';

WITH cli AS (
  INSERT INTO clients (name, rep_email, calendar_link)
  VALUES ('{{ $json.client_name_esc }}', '{{ $json.rep_email_esc }}', NULLIF('{{ $json.calendar_link_esc }}',''))
  ON CONFLICT (name) DO UPDATE SET rep_email = EXCLUDED.rep_email, calendar_link = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.calendar_link, clients.calendar_link)
  RETURNING id
), cfg AS (
  UPDATE app_config SET value = '{{ $json.rep_email_esc }}' WHERE key = 'rep_notification_email'
)
INSERT INTO client_onboarding (client_name, rep_email, calendar_link, sender_account, notes, source, raw)
VALUES ('{{ $json.client_name_esc }}', '{{ $json.rep_email_esc }}', NULLIF('{{ $json.calendar_link_esc }}',''), NULLIF('{{ $json.sender_account_esc }}',''), NULLIF('{{ $json.notes_esc }}',''), 'form', '{{ $json.raw_esc }}'::jsonb)
RETURNING id, client_name, rep_email, (SELECT id FROM cli) AS client_id;

parameters.message:
=Welcome aboard.

Client: {{ $('Validate Submission').item.json.client_name }}
Digest + approval emails will go to: {{ $('Validate Submission').item.json.rep_email }}

What happens next:
1. New account briefs arrive for your review — approve or reject with one click.
2. Approving a brief starts a tracked outreach cadence; you'll get one daily digest with your touches and ready-to-send drafts.
3. Outcomes are measured automatically; when a campaign hits its goal you'll get an opportunity approval email.

No further setup is needed on your side.
